_comment: Price table for the metering proxy. The corporate gateway reports usage TOKENS but no
usage.cost, and BOTH arms enforce their budget by reading usage.cost (AlgoTuner:
So the proxy prices every response from these constants and stamps the result into usage.cost.
The constants are the PUBLISHED OpenRouter list price of the dated slug the campaign was
designed around (docs/47 5a: siliconflow/fp8 at $0.140 in / $0.280 out per 1M). Fetched from
https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models at the timestamp below and PINNED here: a benchmark number
must not move because a vendor re-priced a model between two arms.
The gateway serves 'deepseek-v4-flash' with no snapshot date in the id, so pricing it with the
-0731 list price is an ASSUMPTION, and it is the reason cost_basis says 'imputed'. It does not
affect parity: both arms are priced by the same constants through the same meter.
